_about: Cabinet settings menu (settings_menu.py): the description shown under the list for the chosen item. Plain words, at most 3 lines when wrapped on the pane.
volume: How loud all games and menus are. Push the stick left or right to change it. The level is kept after a restart.
mute: Silences all sound. Press A again to bring the sound back at the same level.
quit: Closes the game you are playing and goes back to the game list.
theme: Changes the look of the game list. Stick left or right to choose, A to apply; the game list restarts. Only available outside games.
guide: Shows what every button on the cabinet does.
info: Shows the network address, how warm the cabinet is, power warnings, whether it is locked, and how much space is free.
lock: Protects the system from accidents such as a power cut: system changes are undone at every restart. Saves, high scores, settings and game lists are always kept. Restarts the cabinet.
unlock: Maintenance mode, for adding games, themes or updates: changes to the system are kept until you lock it again. Restarts the cabinet.
restart: Safely closes the game and the game list (so nothing is lost), then restarts the cabinet.
shutdown: Safely closes everything and turns the cabinet off. It has to be switched on again by hand.
close: Closes this menu and goes back to where you were.
